title: Canonical adjunction of a total small etale augmentation
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U_\bullet$ a simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] of $\operatorname{Sch}/X$, hence an augmented simplicial scheme. Use the total small etale site [def-trf-total-simplicial-etale-site], the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and the common containing universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and use sheaves of constant $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], equivalently sheaves with values in $\Lambda$-modules. The structural functor $p$ sends a total object $(n,W\to U_n)$ to $W\to U_n\to X$ in $\operatorname{Sch}/X$, and sends its morphisms to their underlying maps over $X$. For a total module sheaf $F$, define $a_*F$ to be the restriction of the right Kan extension $\operatorname{Ran}_{p^{op}}F$ to the opposite of the small etale category of $X$. Thus its sections at an etale $V\to X$ are the limit of all $F(n,W)$ over total objects with a map $W\to V$ over $X$, with compatibility under every total-site morphism. This presheaf is a sheaf. The resulting functor $a_*$ has a left adjoint $a^*$; take the ordinary adjunction determined by this right-adjoint construction. The inverse image preserves finite limits (and finite colimits by adjunction), and both functors are additive. Its restriction to degree $n$ is naturally isomorphic to inverse image along $U_n\to X$; in the family description its transitions are the canonical composition comparisons. These constructions require no properness, hypercover, torsion, or boundedness assumption.

/home/ubuntu/weil-newtargets-shared/dag/nodes/sec-smooth-purity/lem-cbc-dold-kan-hypercover-quillen.json:20: "statement": "Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with a Grothendieck topology $J$ given by covering sieves: a sieve is a set of arrows into an object closed under precomposition, the maximal sieve covers, and covering sieves satisfy pullback stability and transitivity. /home/ubuntu/weil-newtargets-shared/dag/nodes/sec-six-functors/lem-coef-cosimplicial-frame-mapping.json:20: "statement": "A model category here is a complete and cocomplete category with classes $C,F,W$ of cofibrations, fibrations and weak equivalences; $W$ satisfies two-out-of-three and is retract closed, and $(C,F\cap W)$ and $(C\cap W,F)$ are weak factorization systems with functorial factorizations.
